Sandbox_ViewpointGaelCompat_CrouchIronFo: Experimental: Crouch enables Iron Sights FOV Change
While crouched and aiming through iron sights, narrow only the view FOV. Attached optics and saved weapon calibrations are unaffected.
Multiplies the weapon's calibrated ADS FOV. Lower values zoom further; 1.00 disables the extra zoom. Default: 0.70.
Sandbox_ViewpointGaelCompat_WheelIronFoc: With iron sights in ADS, wheel up focuses by subtracting 0.30 from the calibrated FOV multiplier; wheel down restores normal ADS FOV. Wheel control takes priority over crouch focus until ADS ends. Scopes keep their own wheel zoom.
Sandbox_ViewpointGaelCompat_Experimental: Experimental: increase all firearm ranges by 50 percent
Extends the effective MaxRange of all aimed firearms by 50 percent. Enabled by default during testing. Gael's dynamic ammo values remain intact. Requires a game restart.
Sandbox_ViewpointGaelCompat_NerfLongDist: Only works when the experimental range increase is enabled. Hits beyond each weapon's original range deal 30 percent less damage to characters. Enabled by default.
Sandbox_ViewpointGaelCompat_NoReferenceH: Experimental: unsupported iron sight hold sway

For the GOL Sniper Magnum without an attached optic, animates the gun and arms after ADS aligns them. Temporary test range: random yaw and pitch targets from 1 to 2 degrees on either side, moving at 0.05-0.2 degrees per 0.25 seconds. Camera and saved calibration stay intact. Enabled by default.
